sources.title: LLM Powered Text Entry Decoding and Flexible Typing on Smartphones
sources.snippet: In this study, we utilized the FLAN-T5 small model as our base LLM due to its practicality and balanced performance-efficiency trade-off. The model only contains 77M parameters and takes 293MB of space on disk, which makes it resource efficient for mobile deployments.

sources.title: T5 (language model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: T5 (Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer) is a series of large language models developed by Google AI introduced in 2019. [1][2] Like the original Transformer model, [3] T5 models are encoder-decoder Transformers, where the encoder processes the input text, and the decoder generates the output text.
